Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 4
Reason for Mistake: The Planner prematurely concluded that Catherine’s father-in-law was Rupert II based on an unverified search snippet, without opening the source or corroborating with additional references. This led to misidentifying John, Count Palatine of Neumarkt’s father (confusing Rupert II with Rupert III), even though the authoritative page later showed he was the son of Rupert III.
